{"type": "json_object", "text": "{\"program\": \"\\nimport json\\n\\n\\ndef run(payload):\\n    # Extract the source lineage from the payload\\n    source_lineage = payload.get('source_lineage', {})\\n\\n\\n    # Check if the source lineage is valid\\n    if not source_lineage or not isinstance(source_lineage, dict):\\n        return emit_allowed({'source_lineage': {'error': 'Invalid source lineage'}})\\n\\n\\n    # Validate required fields\\n    if 'source_name' not in source_lineage or 'source_version' not in source_lineage: \\n        return emit_allowed({'source_lineage': {'error': 'Missing required fields'}})\\n\\n\\n    # Extract source name and version\\n    source_name = source_lineage['source_name']\\n    source_version = source_lineage['source_version']\\n\\n\\n    # Validate source name and version\\n    if not source_name or not source_version: \\n        return emit_allowed({'source_lineage': {'error': 'Empty source name or version'}})\\n\\n\\n    # Emit the source-relative JSON record\\n    return emit_allowed({'source_lineage': {'source_name': source_name, 'source_version': source_version}})\\n\\n\\n\\ndef emit_allowed(payload):\\n    return json.dumps(payload)\\n\\n\\ndef emit_undeclared(payload):\\n    return json.dumps(payload)\\n\\n\""} <|im_end|>
